Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this game! The action from Women's World Cup continues and we have a double-header coming up on Tuesday, 22nd March. It will be South Africa Women taking on Australia Women in the first game of the day which begins at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous night). The second game of the day sees a clash between India Women and Bangladesh Women. This fixture will begin at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT) but you can tune in early for both these games as our build-up will begin much earlier. Cheers!

Bismah Maroof, the skipper of Pakistan Women, says that they are relieved and wanted this win badly. Adds that they played well as a unit and would be looking to continue with the momentum. Tells that they wanted to trust their process and didn't think about the end result. Mentions that Muneeba Ali played well at the start and she batted brilliantly. Says, they want to improve on their mistakes and move forward.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, says that they were looking to score somewhere around 125, but once she came to bat she thought 110 would be good enough. Mentions that the way they played against Bangladesh, they were choked by the spinners and they could not rotate the strike, and the same thing happened here against Pakistan. Informs that Pakistan's spinners did bowl really well. States that they have not been playing their best cricket, and it's a do-or-die situation for them against South Africa.

Nida Dar is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her heroics with the ball. She says that they desperately needed this win and all the girls were ready for the game. Mentions that she was only thinking to bowl in good areas, but she has played her role and she is happy. Informs that as a senior player she is a role model for her teammates and she needed to handle all the pressure. Adds that she is a fan of Shahid Afridi and hence she celebrates like him. Concludes by saying that this win was an inspiration to everyone in Pakistan.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Earlier in the day, it was the rain that kept us waiting for a long period of time but the groundstaff did an amazing job and we were fortunate to get a 20-over game. West Indies Women were favorites going into a 20-over game but Pakistan's spinners had some other plans. It was their spinners who spun a web around Windies' batters and then it was their skipper, Bismah Maroof who led from the front and took her side over the line along with Omaima Sohail.

West Indies Women had a tough task of defending 90 runs and they weren't up to the mark with the ball and also dropped a couple of catches which didn't help their cause either. They needed wickets in quick succession and Pakistan Women denied that. In the end, West Indies Women managed to grab only a couple of wickets and they would be very disappointed with their performance.

Pakistan Women needed just 90 runs off 120 balls but it wasn't going to be an easy chase. They did lose Sidra Ameen early on in the innings but their youngster, Muneeba Ali, who was also playing her first World Cup game, batted sensibly and it was her innings that set the tone for Pakistan Women. Their skipper, Bismah Maroof along with Omaima Sohail batted well and they ensured that there weren't any more hiccups before they get over the line.

Finally, Pakistan Women get a win under their belt. They have also ended their losing streak of 18 games in the Women's World Cup. A comfortable victory in the end for them and it is their bowlers who should be credited for the way they bowled in the first innings. Pakistani batters batted with intent and showed a lot of composure on a tricky surface and in the end, they performed better in all three departments than their opposition.

That's it! Omaima Sohail finishes things off. A length ball, around middle. Omaima Sohail goes for the sweep but the ball goes off the top edge over mid-wicket. They complete the single. Pakistan Women win by 8 wickets!
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Omaima Sohail looks to cut this away but she misses.

Another quick single! Fuller ball, around off. Bismah Maroof drives it towards mid off and runs across to the other end. The fielder there fumbles and that allows the batter to complete the run. Scores are level!
Pitches it up, outside off. Bismah Maroof drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Wide! Fuller ball, wide of off. Bismah Maroof leaves it alone. Wide given! Pakistan Women are two runs away.

Quick single! A fuller ball, around off. Omaima Sohail taps it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but she misses. Omaima Sohail dives and makes her ground. Just 3 needed now.
Back of a length, outside off. Omaima Sohail pulls it towards square leg for a single. 4 needed off two overs.
A low full toss, on middle. Omaima Sohail drives it back to the bowler.
Outside off, fuller balll. Omaima Sohail dabs it towards point.
Slower ball, full and outside off. Omaima Sohail drives it to the fielder at cover, who fails to grab the ball. The ball rolls away towards deep cover. The batters take two runs.
Deandra Dottin misses her length again. Another full toss on middle. Omaima Sohail pulls it towards deep square leg for couple of runs!

In the air....but that falls safely! A full toss, around middle. Omaima Sohail looks to heave this away, but the ball goes off the top edge towards deep square leg and lands short of the fielder there. Two taken!
Deandra Dottin comes into the attack.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Omaima Sohail knocks it past mid-wicket for a single. 11 needed off 18 balls.
Another pitched up delivery, on middle. Omaima Sohail defends it out.
Much fuller and slower, on middle. Omaima Sohail pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Omaima Sohail stays in her crease and pushes it towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Bismah Maroof dabs it towards point for a single.
Full, outside off. Bismah Maroof leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.

Tosses it up, full, on middle. Bismah Maroof gets down on her knee and reverse-sweeps this past the diving fielder at point. The ball will not go all the way, but the batters take three runs! 13 needed of 24 balls now.
Shorter ball, turning in, around middle. Omaima Sohail pulls it over mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten! Fuller, loopy delivery as well, outside off. Omaima Sohail looks to go inside-out over cover but she misses.
Slower through the air, full toss, around middle. Bismah Maroof flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, quicker and wide of off. Bismah Maroof leaves it alone.
A full toss, on middle. Omaima Sohail sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
This is a length ball, around off. Bismah Maroof prods and keeps it out. 19 runs needed off 30 balls.
Fuller in length, outside off. Bismah Maroof drives it through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
Back of a length, outside off. Bismah Maroof taps it towards point.
A full ball, on middle. Omaima Sohail drives it back past the bowler towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Another ball, full and outside off. Bismah Maroof slices it to point and manages only a single.

No ball! A length ball, on middle. Omaima Sohail drags it past the mid-wicket fielder for a single. Shakera Selman oversteps and a Free Hit to follow. This is the last thing that West Indies Women would have wanted at this stage.
Fuller in length, outside off. Omaima Sohail gets forward and drives it to the cover fielder.

Floated, on a length, around off. Omaima Sohail waits for the ball to turn and then guides it through third man for a single. The fielder there fumbles but she prevents the second run. 25 runs needed off 36 balls.
FOUR! Shot of some authority from Omaima Sohail! Tossed up, on middle. Sohail clears her front leg and goes inside-out through covers for a cracking boundary.
Floated, on a length and outside off. Omaima Sohail prods and defends it to the off side.
Cheeky from Omaima Sohail! This is tossed up, on middle. Sohail gets low and paddles it over the keeper's head for a brace.
Tossed up, on middle. Omaima Sohail pushes it back to the bowler.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Omaima Sohail drives it towards mid off.
BEATEN! A slower ball, on a length and outside off. Bismah Maroof has a poke at it but she misses. 32 runs needed off 42 balls.
Fuller in length, outside off. Bismah Maroof lets it through to the keeper.
This is darted on the pads. Sohail tucks it around the corner and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, on middle. Omaima Sohail keeps it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time Muneeba Ali does not get lucky! A harsh short from her and that probably was not needed at this stage but West Indies Women have another wicket! Shakera Selman strikes and gets the big wicket of Muneeba Ali. A length ball, outside off. Muneeba Ali swings her bat wildly across the line, and the ball goes off the top edge towards point. Deandra Dottin there takes a simple catch. Omaima Sohail walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Shakera Selman

Commentary.Commentary: PUT DOWN! Also, a run out chance goes begging! Back of a length, outside off. Muneeba Ali cuts it hard and uppishly straight to Hayley Matthews at cover, who dives to her left but puts it down. The extra cover fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses They complete one run. The batters look to sneak in one more run. The fielder in the deep throws it towards the keeper who fails to grab it cleanly and Muneeba Ali escapes a run out chance. Muneeba Ali gets lucky here!
Shakera Selman comes into the attack.
A quicker ball, on a length, around off. Bismah Maroof defends it off the back foot. 35 runs needed off 48 balls.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Bismah Maroof keeps it out.
Slightly shorter in length, on middle. Muneeba Ali rocks back and pulls it aerially towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball, outside off. Muneeba defends it to the off side and does not take a single this time.
Tossed up, outside off. Muneeba Ali prods and works it to the cover fielder.
This is darted on the pads. Bismah Maroof rocks back and tickles it to fine leg for a run.
Tap and run! This is excellent batting from these two! Flatter ball, on off. Bismah Maroof defends it to cover and takes a single.
Around off. Pushed towards cover.
Floated, full and on middle. Muneeba Ali mistimes her slog sweep over the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! The youngster is taking on the experienced Anisa Mohammed! This is tossed up, on midle. Muneeba whacks it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary. 50 comes up for Pakistan Women!
Shorter in length, around middle. Maroof rocks back and eases it to long on for a run.
Flatter ball, around leg. Muneeba Ali tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Very full, around middle. Bismah Maroof drives it to the fielder at mid on.
Tad fuller now, around off. Muneeba Ali opens the face of her bat and pushes it towards point for a single.
Tad shorter now, around middle once again. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards square leg.
Flatter ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Bismah Maroof tucks it towards fine leg for a brace.
Full, outside off. Muneeba Ali squeezes it out towards point for single.
Fraction shorter, around middle. Muneeba Ali looks to defend this, but the ball comes in and she misses and gets hit on her pads.
Hayley Matthews (2-1-9-0) is back on.
Full, on middle. Muneeba Ali sweeps it towards square leg for a single. She retains the strike!
FOUR! Top shot! Muneeba Ali was getting a little impatient there but gets the desired result now! Another fuller ball, outside off. Muneeba Ali slashes it past cover-point for a boundary.
Full, outside off. Muneeba Ali blocks it out.
Another loopy ball, full, around middle. Muneeba Ali advances down and lifts it towards mid off, who collects it on the bounce.
Another flighted delivery, full, around off. Muneeba Ali steps down and knocks it towards mid off.
Tosses it up, very full, outside off. Muneeba Ali defends it out.
Tad shorter on middle. Bismah Maroof nudges it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Wide! A googly, full, down leg. Bismah Maroof leaves it alone. Wide called!
Quick single! Tad shorter, around middle. Muneeba Ali taps it gently towards the off side and runs across to the other end.
Much fuller now, outside off, loopy ball. Muneeba Ali leans and drives it towards mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter ball, width on offer. Muneeba Ali stays in her crease and slashes it past point for a cracking boundary.
Loopy delivery, around middle. Muneeba Ali sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple of runs!
Tosses it up, on middle, fuller ball. Bismah Maroof clips it towards square leg for a single.
Loopy delivery, on middle. Muneeba Ali knocks it towards mid on.
Turning away, outside off, fuller ball. Muneeba Ali slashes it to the fielder at cover-point.
Tad fuller, spinning away, outside off. Bismah Maroof pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end. Muneeba Ali dives to make her ground at the keeper's end.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Bismah Maroof chops it towards point for a brace.
Full again, outside off. Bismah Maroof drives it towards cover.

Review! West Indies Women opt for a review after Bismah Maroof is struck on her pad. The UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball was pitched outside leg and West Indies Women lose a review.

NOT OUT! A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no! Loopy ball, full, darting it on the pads. Bismah Maroof looks to flick this away, but she misses. West Indies Women opts for a review! No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows it was pitching outside leg.
Fuller ball, outside off, Muneeba Ali leaves it alone.
Shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Muneeba Ali jabs it away towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, spins in, fuller ball. Muneeba Ali leaves it alone.
Shorter ball, around middle. Bismah Maroof works it away towards square leg for a single.
Bismah Maroof walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Afy Fletcher draws first blood. West Indies Women need more of these! Toses it up again, very full, on middle. Sidra Ameen gets down on her knee and looks to sweep but she misses as the ball spins away and goes on to crash the middle stumps. Sidra Ameen departs.
A loopy ball, very full, around middle. Sidra Ameen back away and pushes it towards mid on.
Afy Fletcher comes into the attack.
Edged but safe! Tossed up, just outside off. Ali looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and runs past the slip fielder for a brace.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Muneeba Ali drives it through the cover region and takes a couple.
Floated, full and around off. Muneeba Ali looks to sweep but she gets an inside edge onto her pad.
Sharp turn! This is tossed up, around off and spinning away from the batter. Muneeba Ali looks to block but the ball beats her outside edge.
Slightly shorter in length, on off. Ameen shuffles across and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Ameen looks to play a premeditated reverse-sweep but Anisa Mohammed serves it around leg. Ameen manages to work it to cover in the end.
Anisa Mohammed comes into the attack now.
Good running! A length ball, around off. Sidra Ameen pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end. Pakistan Women are 17/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Edged but it doesn't carry to the keeper! A length ball, outside off. Sidra Ameen looks to heave it away but she gets a bottom edge that lands just in front of the keeper.
On a length, darted on the pads. Muneeba Ali tickles it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, around middle. Ameen swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Another swing and a miss! Shorter in length, well outside off. Ameen looks to cut hard but she fails to get any bat on it.
Back of a length, outside off. Sidra Ameen looks to cut but she misses.
Floated, full and on off. Muneeba Ali blocks it out.
FOUR! Edgy! Flighted ball, on a length, around off and spinning away late. Muneeba Ali looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge, just past the slip fielder and it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, on middle. Muneeba Ali kneels and sweeps it through square leg to bag a boundary.
Peach of a delivery from Matthews! Flatter ball, going on with the angle from off and it straightens after landing. Muneeba Ali gets forward to block but the ball goes past her outside edge.
Flatter ball, going on with the arm. Muneeba Ali keeps it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Sidra Ameen kneels and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Sidra Ameen steers it to third man and takes a single.
On a length, around off. Muneeba Ali taps it towards backward point and sets off for a quick run. Muneeba is off the mark!
This is a length ball, on middle. Ameen works it to mid on and scampers through to the other end.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, shaping away from outside off. Sidra Ameen looks to drive on the up but she misses.
Short of a length, outside off. Sidra Ameen taps it towards backward point.
Back of a length, on middle. Sidra Ameen just helps it behind square on the leg side and takes a couple of runs. Pakistan Women are up and running!
Chinelle Henry will bowl from the other end.
Floated, full and around off. Muneeba Ali blocks it off the front foot. A maiden over to start with!
This is a flatter ball, around off. Muneeba Ali lets it be.
Tossed up, outside off. Muneeba Ali drives it to the cover fielder.
On a length, and well outside off. Ali sways away from the line of the ball.
Flatter and quicker, outside off and turning away late. Ali does not bother playing at it.
Floated, outside off. Muneeba Ali leaves it alone.
